shortDescription: Manage an EasyRSA-based Public Key Infrastructure.

options.name: ca_keysize
options.description: RSA key size in bits for the certificate authority key.

options.name: dh_keysize
options.description: RSA key size in bits for Diffie-Hellman parameter generation.

options.name: force
options.description: Remove an existing PKI directory before recreating it. Use this only when a full PKI rebuild is intended.

options.name: pki_dir
options.description: Absolute or relative path to the PKI directory. Certificates, keys, requests, and related PKI artifacts are stored in this directory.

options.name: req_cn_ca
options.description: Common Name to use when creating the certificate authority.

options.name: req_cn_server
options.description: Common Name to use when generating the server certificate request.

options.name: working_dir
options.description: Working directory used before executing EasyRSA operations. If omitted, the current process working directory is used.
